summary: Silvaco Group, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to amend its existing at-the-market offering program, increasing the total amount of common stock that may be offered and sold from $15.0 million to $35.0 million (net of ~$4.3 million already sold). The issuer utilizes Jefferies LLC as sales agent, receiving up to 3.0% commission. This is an ordinary shelf takedown with no special-situation features such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring. The change reflects the company achieving a public float above $75 million, allowing it to rely on General Instruction I.B.1 of Form S-3 beyond the 'baby shelf' limitation. The ATM program terms, including method of sale and compensation, remain unchanged. No deal terms apply.
